```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
source("../_common.R")

all_shots <- read.csv("../data/allshots-2003-2024.csv")

kobe_shots <- all_shots %>%
  filter(namePlayer == "Kobe Bryant") %>%
  mutate(
    court_zone = case_when(
      distanceShot <= 8 ~ "Paint",
      distanceShot > 8 & distanceShot < 23 ~ "Mid-Range",
      distanceShot >= 23 ~ "3PT",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

kobe_career <- tibble(
  era = c("Early (1996-2003)", "Prime (2004-2010)", "Late (2011-2016)"),
  ppg = c(19.9, 28.2, 21.7),
  fg_pct = c(44.9, 45.5, 39.2),
  championships = c(3, 2, 0)
)
```

> *"The moment you give up is the moment you let someone else win."* – Kobe Bryant

## The Relentless Path to Mastery

Kobe Bryant didn't believe in shortcuts. While other kids slept, he practiced. While teammates rested, he studied film. His 4 a.m. workouts became legendary—not because they were extreme, but because they were consistent.

**The Mamba Mentality wasn't about talent. It was about refusing to be outworked.**

## Work Ethic Isn't Glamorous

The stories of Kobe's work ethic are almost mythological: making 400 shots before practice, watching film of his opponents' tendencies, learning footwork from Hakeem Olajuwon during offseasons.

```{r shot-evolution, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Kobe's shot selection evolved across his career phases"

kobe_by_year <- kobe_shots %>%
  group_by(yearSeason) %>%
  summarize(
    paint = sum(court_zone == "Paint") / n() * 100,
    midrange = sum(court_zone == "Mid-Range") / n() * 100,
    three = sum(court_zone == "3PT") / n() * 100
  )

highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "area") %>%
  hc_title(text = "Kobe's Shot Selection Evolution (2003-2016)") %>%
  hc_xAxis(categories = kobe_by_year$yearSeason) %>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "% of Shots")) %>%
  hc_add_series(name = "Paint", data = round(kobe_by_year$paint, 1), color = "#552583") %>%
  hc_add_series(name = "Mid-Range", data = round(kobe_by_year$midrange, 1), color = "#FDB927") %>%
  hc_add_series(name = "3PT", data = round(kobe_by_year$three, 1), color = "#000000") %>%
  hc_plotOptions(area = list(stacking = "normal")) %>%
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme_flatdark())
```

## Reinvention is Survival

When age stole his athleticism, Kobe adapted. He became a post-up threat, a three-point shooter, a facilitator. The torn Achilles that ended most careers became another obstacle to overcome.

```{r career-phases, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Kobe maintained elite scoring across different phases of his career"

highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "column") %>%
  hc_title(text = "Kobe's Scoring by Career Phase") %>%
  hc_xAxis(categories = kobe_career$era) %>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Points Per Game")) %>%
  hc_add_series(
    name = "PPG",
    data = kobe_career$ppg,
    colorByPoint = TRUE,
    colors = c("#552583", "#FDB927", "#000000")
  ) %>%
  hc_plotOptions(column = list(dataLabels = list(enabled = TRUE, format = "{y:.1f}"))) %>%
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme_flatdark())
```

## The 81-Point Game

On January 22, 2006, Kobe scored 81 points against the Toronto Raptors—the second-highest single-game total in NBA history. It wasn't just scoring; it was a statement about what's possible when preparation meets opportunity.

| Achievement | Value |
|------------|-------|
| Career Points | 33,643 |
| Championships | 5 |
| MVPs | 1 |
| All-Star Games | 18 |
| 60+ Point Games | 6 |
| 81-Point Game | Yes |

::: {.callout-tip}
## Lessons from Mamba Mentality

1. **Outwork everyone** - Talent is common; elite work ethic is rare
2. **Study obsessively** - Kobe knew his opponents better than they knew themselves
3. **Adapt or fade** - He reinvented his game multiple times
4. **Embrace pressure** - Big moments were opportunities, not obstacles
:::
